Sociable Cider x Recovery Bike Shop Wednesday Social Ride

Minneapolis, MN · Northeast · Social

No-dropBeginner friendly

Sociable Cider x Recovery Bike Shop Wednesday Social Ride is a social group ride in Minneapolis, MN. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:00 pm from Sociable Cider Werks. About 8–10 miles, social, meandering pace. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: social, meandering pace. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @recoverybikeshop the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Sociable Cider x Recovery Bike Shop Wednesday Social Ride group ride

A slow, meandering loop through Northeast that starts and ends at the cider taproom. Recovery Bike Shop sends mechanical support. Riders get a pint of cider at the finish. Cancellations for weather or holidays get posted on the shop's Instagram.
